annotation.title_clean: Guidelines for providers and deployers of AI high-risk systems
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for providers and deployers of AI high-risk systems
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page presenting draft, non-binding guidelines on classifying AI systems as high-risk under the AI Act, with practical examples. A targeted consultation is open until 23 July 2026. Following the AI Omnibus, rules for products integrated with AI, such as robotics and machinery, apply from 2 August 2028.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft guidelines clarify classification of high-risk AI systems under the AI Act, with non-exhaustive examples
Guidelines are not legally binding but reflect the Commission's interpretation and will guide enforcement
Targeted stakeholder consultation open until 23 July 2026
Rules for high-risk areas such as biometrics, education and employment apply from 2 December 2027
Rules for AI integrated in products such as robotics and industrial machinery apply from 2 August 2028
